subject.title: fix(boundary-safety): guard response reads and UTF-16 truncation

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this 210-entry baseline-backed boundary-safety guard as a required full and changed-file validation gate now?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent and exact-head checks are green, but making a new source-invariant guard required changes CI and contributor workflow policy beyond a narrow runtime bug fix.

options.title: Accept The Guard
options.body: Merge after final maintainer review if this validator should become the canonical enforcement path for new raw UTF-16 truncation and unbounded Response reads.

options.title: Narrow Before Merge
options.body: Keep the shared helper fixes but make the guard advisory, smaller in scope, or split into a separate maintainer-owned policy PR.

options.title: Pause The Proposal
options.body: Leave the narrower merged runtime fixes in place and defer or close the broad validation gate if the CI policy cost is not worth adopting now.

recommendation.title: Accept The Guard
recommendation.body: Merge after final maintainer review if this validator should become the canonical enforcement path for new raw UTF-16 truncation and unbounded Response reads.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice is mostly repository validation policy, and recent related history points to vincentkoc across adjacent helper and validation surfaces.
